hero_prop_criteria.center_of_focus: The story, a shot or a character's attention centres on the object.
hero_prop_criteria.high_frequency: The object is present in more than one scene/act.
hero_prop_criteria.transfer: The object passes between two characters.

scenes.heading: EXT. SABA ELIOR’S COURTYARD — LATE MORNING

hero_props.name: Yonah’s small lunch
aliases: Five barley loaves and two fish
hero_props.description: Yonah’s five barley loaves and two fish, first carried in a small bundle, then given to Andrew and Jesus, multiplied, distributed, eaten, and gathered as leftovers. The same lunch changes form through the miracle as bread and fish multiply.
hero_props.reason: This is the central miracle prop: it drives the biblical story beat, recurs through the whole hillside sequence, and passes from Yonah to Andrew, to Jesus, and then outward to the crowd.

hero_props.name: Miri’s honey-date cakes
hero_props.description: Three honey-date cakes wrapped in Miri’s cloth bundle. They begin as guarded treats, become the object of Miri’s generosity lesson, and are ultimately shared with Tav and Nim.
hero_props.reason: They drive Miri’s central conflict about giving, recur from the cold open through the resolution, and are physically given to Tav and Nim.

hero_props.name: Linen basket and folded linen
hero_props.description: The basket of folded linen Ima sends with Miri for Saba Elior. It carries the cakes, brings Miri to Saba, and remains a recurring practical object around the story frame.
hero_props.reason: It recurs across the village and scroll-room frame and is physically handed from Ima to Miri, with the linen then given to Saba.

hero_props.name: Miracle baskets
hero_props.description: The baskets used during and after the feeding miracle: one holds the bread near Jesus, many pass through the crowd, and twelve are filled with leftovers.
hero_props.reason: The baskets visually carry the miracle, recur through the distribution and leftovers sequence, and one basket is handed over to Andrew after gathering.

hero_props.name: The small scroll of the loaves and fish
hero_props.description: A small scroll tied with a barley-colored cord and sealed with the image of a loaf and two fish. It opens the miraculous story-world and later rests glowing on its shelf.
hero_props.reason: The scroll is the portal and physical focus of Saba’s lesson, appearing before, after, and at the close of the story.

hero_props.name: Tav’s broken toy cart
hero_props.description: Tav’s small toy cart with a loose wheel. It appears broken when Miri first refuses him a cake, then is repaired with a peg after she returns to share.
hero_props.reason: The cart is a recurring Tav subplot prop that shows his need and becomes part of Miri’s changed behavior; Nim supplies a peg that lets Miri repair it.
